question: Does the publicly displayed author-uploaded copy add site-level evidence beyond the official UPLB abstract?

source.uploadProvenance: ResearchGate labels one public full-text item as author content uploaded by coauthor Ian Kendrich Carandang Fontanilla on 2015-10-08 and warns that content may be subject to copyright.
source.accessNote: The web-visible author-uploaded full-text content was read for the study-site passage. No PDF was downloaded or retained. The official UPLB record continues to show that its repository copy is unavailable.

additionalStudyScope.studyDesignAsReported: The article describes seven localities from five lakes and one river: two areas of Laguna de Bay and one locality each at Sampaloc Lake, Taal Lake, Paoay Lake, Maasin River, and Lake Buhi.
additionalStudyScope.maasinSiteAsReported: The text says samples were collected from Maasin River, described as a tributary of the Pampanga River, in Barangay San Agustin, Candaba, Pampanga.
additionalStudyScope.historicalOccurrenceContext: The article cites Habito (1988) as an earlier report of Leiopotherapon plumbeus in Candaba Swamp and describes the Maasin River population as native. This article also reports its own Maasin River samples, but the available passage does not establish their collection date or specimen lineage.
remainingResolutionLimits: The study reports 844 specimens in aggregate across all seven localities; a Maasin-specific sample count was not found.
No Maasin collection date, exact station coordinate, voucher/catalog number, accession, or specimen-to-site record was found in the reviewed text.
The article cites the 1988 thesis for earlier occurrence context; independent sample identity and any overlap with earlier surveys remain unverified.
The paper's reference to a river tributary and barangay is not a channel centerline, surveyed boundary, or fish-location geometry.

accessAndReuse.fullTextAccess: ResearchGate exposes a public full-text item attributed to the author uploader; the official UPLB repository item itself remains unavailable.
accessAndReuse.itemSpecificLicense: ResearchGate explicitly warns that the content may be subject to copyright. No article-specific open license or permission to redistribute the text, tables, or figures was verified.
accessAndReuse.decision: Use the author-uploaded copy only as a research reading lead. Keep article text, tables, figures, derived app rows, and redistribution on hold pending item-specific rights review.

nextAction: For any future data extraction or redistribution, verify an item-specific license or obtain permission; if specimen-level mapping is needed, seek the study's Maasin sample count, dates, and voucher trail from an authorized article copy or collection record.

sources.supports: ResearchGate's author-upload provenance and copyright warning, the seven-locality study scope, the reported Maasin River tributary and Barangay San Agustin site, and the article's citation to Habito (1988).
Official UPLB citation and abstract-level aggregate; the repository record states its document is currently unavailable.
